Text:
Title: Climate Change and Human Health 
 
1. Causes of Climate Change 
   - Greenhouse gas emissions from burning fossil fuels. 
   - Deforestation reducing carbon absorption. 
   - Industrial pollution and urbanization. 
   - Agriculture practices releasing methane. 
 
2. Impacts on Human Health 
   - Increased heatwaves leading to heatstroke and dehydration. 
   - Spread of vector-borne diseases like malaria and dengue. 
   - Poor air quality causing asthma and respiratory illnesses. 
   - Water scarcity and food insecurity. 
 
3. Mitigation Strategies 
   - Transitioning to renewable energy (solar, wind, hydro). 
   - Reforestation and sustainable agriculture. 
   - Public health awareness campaigns. 
   - International cooperation and climate policy agreements. 
 
4. Adaptation for Health 
   - Strengthening healthcare systems to deal with climate-driven diseases. 
   - Developing early warning systems for extreme weather. 
   - Improving access to clean water and nutritious food. 
   - Community-based adaptation projects.
